memory.title_en: XDC 2026 DRM SVM: range, large-page, fault-mode and multi-device convergence
memory.impact_zh: 第一版 recoverable fault 数据模型应解耦 SVM range、CPU page、migration unit、GPU PTE 与 TLB 粒度。
memory.impact_en: Decouple SVM range, CPU page, migration unit, GPU PTE and TLB granularity from the first recoverable-fault design.

virt.title_zh: VFIO PCI error recovery RFC v2：16 patches
virt.title_en: VFIO PCI error recovery RFC v2: 16 patches
virt.impact_zh: PF/host recovery、VF/VMM recovery-state notification 与 recovery-window access gate 应成为显式 contract。
virt.impact_en: Make PF/host recovery, VF/VMM recovery-state notification and recovery-window access gating explicit contracts.

ras.title_zh: Xe wedge isolation v2：15 patches 的 common device-I/O gate
ras.title_en: Xe wedge isolation v2: 15-patch common device-I/O gate
ras.impact_zh: Gate、recovery generation、health state 分离；block new access 后 drain existing readers 再 reset/isolate。
ras.impact_en: Separate gate, recovery generation and health state; block new access and drain readers before reset/isolation.

multi.title_zh: PCI/P2PDMA v9：按 TLP class 路由 P2P
multi.title_en: PCI/P2PDMA v9: route P2P by TLP class
multi.impact_zh: P2P capability 从 topology bool 升级为 direction/TLP/address-type/ATS/ACS-aware matrix；v9 暂移除 dma-buf/mlx5 patch。
multi.impact_en: Upgrade P2P from a topology boolean to a direction/TLP/address-type/ATS/ACS-aware matrix; v9 temporarily drops dma-buf/mlx5 patches.

obs.title_zh: AMDGPU profiler/SPM UAPI：先定义 resource ownership 再冻结接口
obs.title_en: AMDGPU profiler/SPM UAPI: define resource ownership before freezing interface
obs.impact_zh: 先建模 profiler session 的 partition/identity/buffer/generation/lifetime，再选择 perf_event/ioctl/UMD/FW service。
obs.impact_en: Model profiler session partition, identity, buffer, generation and lifetime before choosing perf_event/ioctl/UMD/FW service.

fw.title_zh: Nova r000 GSP v3：33 patches 的 ABI 迁移
fw.title_en: Nova r000 GSP v3: 33-patch ABI migration
fw.impact_zh: 先建立 firmware-version-independent lower layer，再切换 provider；Transport/Envelope/Service 应分层。
fw.impact_en: Build a firmware-version-independent lower layer before switching providers; separate Transport/Envelope/Service.
